Lesson Plan Generator

Build a formatted lesson plan from objectives, materials, activities and timing.

Lesson plan





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Enter subject, grade level and duration.
  2. List objectives and materials, one per line.
  3. Add activities with a duration in minutes each.
  4. Click Generate Plan, then copy or download it.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
How do I create a plan?
Fill in subject, grade, duration, objectives, materials and activities with times, then click Generate Plan.
Can I set timings per activity?
Yes — the activity list stores each activity with its duration in minutes, and the plan shows a timed schedule.
How do I copy or download the plan?
Click Copy Plan to copy the formatted text, or Download to save it as a .txt file.
Are plans saved?
No — plans are generated fresh each time from your inputs. Download to keep a copy.
